need: Hazard row: the first volume of Bastiat's collected works is staged as Project Gutenberg's ISO-8859-1 plain text — 1 085 504 bytes, the only distribution Gutenberg serves for this ebook. Zotero indexed the first 500 000 characters of it from the file, so the item is genuinely searchable inside the client; but text/plain is not a cached MIME type and the local API's fulltext route answers 404, so the export holds no text for it. The 1830 election address to the voters of the Landes is at character 488 310 — inside even the 500 000-character extraction ceiling — and still unreachable.
